subject: Re: calibration hook
body: Agreed: I'll call sensing.record(seconds, label) with label = emotion id, plus one 'neutral' block before the three emotions. Recall is 20 s per label (your floor) to fit the demo; I've asked a person whether to go to 40-60 s for real use. Please return a quality flag so a single short window is treated as a prior. I'll make the duration a parameter so we can change it without touching the flow.
